columns.name: school_id

columns.name: first_sy_in_data
columns.description: First school year the school appears in any district list.

columns.name: last_sy_in_data
columns.description: Last school year the school appears in any district list (2027 means the 2026-27 list).

columns.name: year_opened
columns.description: Year the school opened, as the district reports it.

columns.name: listed_in_latest_year
columns.description: True if the school is on the most recent district school list.

columns.name: record_kind
columns.description: school for schools on the district's lists; otherwise a placeholder for a program that appears only in state data (for example 'program outside the district list').

columns.name: governance
columns.description: District, Charter, Contracted, or other, as the district's school list gives it.

columns.name: level
columns.description: Elementary, Middle, High, or a combination, as the district's school list gives it.

columns.name: admission_type

columns.name: council_district

columns.name: asbestos_items
columns.description: Asbestos-containing materials on record. Entries in the building's room-by-room asbestos log that are confirmed or assumed to contain asbestos (one entry per material per space), from the most recent 6-month or 3-year AHERA report.
columns.usage_notes: Extracted from the district's AHERA reports. Managed in place, intact asbestos is legal and common in older buildings; the count reflects building age and size as much as risk. Amounts by unit (SF, LF, EA) are in building_asbestos. Annexes have their own building codes and are not added to the main school.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time: the most recent report, mostly 2025-26. sy = school year of the report.

columns.name: asbestos_items_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the asbestos_items value is from.

columns.name: asbestos_items_damaged
columns.description: Asbestos-containing materials with damage. Confirmed or assumed asbestos entries with a damaged amount above zero at the most recent inspection.
columns.usage_notes: Damage as the inspector recorded it; repairs after the inspection appear in the next report. Damaged amounts by unit are in building_asbestos.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time; see asbestos_items.

columns.name: asbestos_items_damaged_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the asbestos_items_damaged value is from.

columns.name: building_capacity_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the building_capacity value is from.

columns.name: catchment_size

columns.name: catchment_size_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the catchment_size value is from.

columns.name: cep_econ_disadvantaged_rate_sy

columns.name: enrollment_count
columns.description: Enrolled students. Students enrolled at the school on the October 1 count, by grade and student group.
columns.usage_notes: Groups under the district's threshold are suppressed (2009-10 to 2013-14: whole rows with 20 or fewer students). Economically disadvantaged counts exist only for 2012-13 and 2013-14 and use a different method from the later CEP rate.
columns.breaks: Coverage break between 2013-14 and 2014-15: files for 2009-10 to 2013-14 cover district schools only (131,894 students in 2013-14); from 2014-15 they include charter and alternative schools (197,694). Do not draw a trend line across that break without labeling it. 2014-15 to 2018-19 files were reposted in Aug 2025 under new suppression rules. 2010-11 Black, Hispanic, American Indian, and multiracial counts are withheld (zeros in the source; corrections/enrollment.csv).

columns.name: enrollment_count_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the enrollment_count value is from.

columns.name: fca_condition_score_pct
columns.description: Facility condition score. Parsons condition score for the site (100% minus FCI, as reported).
columns.usage_notes: Higher is better. Site figures: a site's buildings and grounds together; schools sharing a site each get its figures. Detail by building in facility_condition_part and by system in facility_condition_system.
columns.breaks: 2020 assessment cycle by Parsons; reports dated 2021-22; 76 district sites (the reports the district posted). sy = school year of the report date.

columns.name: fca_condition_score_pct_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the fca_condition_score_pct value is from.

columns.name: fca_fci_pct
columns.description: Facility condition index (FCI). Cost of the site's assessed repair needs divided by its replacement value.
columns.usage_notes: District tiers: under 15% minimal; 15-25% refurbish systems; 25-45% replace systems; 45-60% consider major renovation; over 60% consider closing or replacement. Higher is worse. Site figures: a site's buildings and grounds together; schools sharing a site each get its figures. Detail by building in facility_condition_part and by system in facility_condition_system.
columns.breaks: 2020 assessment cycle by Parsons; reports dated 2021-22; 76 district sites (the reports the district posted). sy = school year of the report date.

columns.name: fca_fci_pct_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the fca_fci_pct value is from.

columns.name: fca_school_score_pct
columns.description: Overall school facility score. Parsons combined score of condition and suitability.
columns.usage_notes: Higher is better; missing for 8 sites. Site figures: a site's buildings and grounds together; schools sharing a site each get its figures. Detail by building in facility_condition_part and by system in facility_condition_system.
columns.breaks: 2020 assessment cycle by Parsons; reports dated 2021-22; 76 district sites (the reports the district posted). sy = school year of the report date.

columns.name: fca_school_score_pct_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the fca_school_score_pct value is from.

columns.name: fca_suitability_score_pct
columns.description: Educational suitability score. How well the building suits its educational program (space, layout, specialized rooms), as Parsons scored it.
columns.usage_notes: Higher is better; missing for 8 sites. Site figures: a site's buildings and grounds together; schools sharing a site each get its figures. Detail by building in facility_condition_part and by system in facility_condition_system.
columns.breaks: 2020 assessment cycle by Parsons; reports dated 2021-22; 76 district sites (the reports the district posted). sy = school year of the report date.

columns.name: lead_paint_components_positive
columns.description: Painted components with lead paint. Components the inspector called positive for lead-based paint, in the most recent full assessment.
columns.usage_notes: The inspector's call as published. Firms cite different cutoffs; school_lead_paint also has the count at or above the federal 1.0 mg/cm2 level. Intact lead paint is managed in place; damaged lead paint is the hazard.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time; see lead_paint_components_tested.

columns.name: lead_paint_components_positive_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the lead_paint_components_positive value is from.

columns.name: lead_paint_components_tested
columns.description: Painted components tested for lead (XRF). Painted surfaces (walls, door frames, sills, radiators, ...) tested with an XRF analyzer in the school's most recent full lead-safe assessment, summed over its buildings.
columns.usage_notes: Extracted from the district's lead-safe assessment PDFs (env results module). Schools sharing a building each get the building's figures. Buildings that are not schools (annexes, field houses, offices) are in school_lead_paint only.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time: one assessment per building, done in different years (2017 to 2026). sy = school year the assessment ended.

columns.name: lead_paint_components_tested_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the lead_paint_components_tested value is from.

columns.name: lead_paint_positive_damaged
columns.description: Lead-painted components with damaged paint. Components positive for lead paint that also had damaged (flaking, peeling, chipping) paint at assessment, the hazard lead-safe certification requires fixing.
columns.usage_notes: Damage was recorded before stabilization; a later certification report may show it fixed. Square feet are in school_lead_paint.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time; see lead_paint_components_tested.

columns.name: lead_paint_positive_damaged_sy
columns.description: School year (sy) the lead_paint_positive_damaged value is from.

columns.name: water_outlets_above_action
columns.description: Drinking water outlets above the lead action level. Outlets whose first sample was above the district's 10 ppb action level in the most recent test (the outlet is shut off, then fixed and retested).
columns.usage_notes: The district's action level (10 ppb) is stricter than the federal 15 ppb level for water systems. Follow-up letters (follow_up = true in school_water_lead) record the corrective action and retest result.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time; see water_outlets_tested.

columns.name: water_outlets_tested
columns.description: Drinking water outlets tested for lead. Water outlets (hydration stations, fountains, faucets, food-prep and ice-maker outlets) sampled in the school's most recent lead-in-water test, summed over its buildings.
columns.usage_notes: Extracted from the district's water results letters. Schools sharing a building each get the building's figures. Results for each outlet are in school_water_lead.
columns.breaks: Point-in-time: the district retests each school every five years; most current letters are from 2025 and 2026. sy = school year of sampling.
